{

    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {

    "triggered_rules": []
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an auditable upward reserve-sizing study for MISO with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 10.0. Only decision-time admissible variables are used: calendar, cost ratio, current load, horizon, lagged load, load statistics, observed weather, recent ramp, and region ID. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "The operator request maps to the allowed upward_reserve_sizing task with supported region MISO, supported horizon 120 minutes, supported shortfall cost 10.0, and only decision-time admissible variables. No future information, test-residual leakage, raw-data modification, fabricated results, hidden audit bypass, approval bypass, or system-prompt override is requested.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_operator_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "record_numerical_workflow_outputs_in_evidence_trace",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
}
